Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in its "Updated Understanding" section. While the WebSurfer correctly identified the album as "Why Is There Air?" (1965) and the recording venue as the "Flamingo Hotel in Las Vegas, Nevada," the Planner incorrectly concluded that the location was "Reno, Nevada" and renamed the venue "Flamingo Reno." The Flamingo Hotel in Las Vegas (where Cosby recorded the album) is a different entity from the Flamingo Hilton in Reno (which was later renamed Flamingo Reno). The Planner hallucinated the city as Reno based on the name "Flamingo" without verifying the specific location mentioned in the search results (Las Vegas).
